# Griffith Creative

> Boutique web design studio based in Los Angeles, serving growing businesses and established brands worldwide. Builds high-performance websites engineered for both traditional search and AI answer engines (ChatGPT, Claude, Perplexity, Google AI Overviews).

Griffith Creative ships agency-grade websites in weeks rather than months. Every site is engineered for speed, semantic structure, schema.org markup, and AI citation visibility.

## Services

- [Custom Design & Build](https://www.griffithcreative.co/services): Website design, copy, and development scoped to the business rather than a fixed page count. Includes mobile-responsive design, semantic structure, metadata and schema, AI search optimization, contact forms, analytics and conversion tracking, custom integrations (booking, CRM, e-commerce), edge hosting, and revision rounds.
- [Enterprise Partnerships](https://www.griffithcreative.co/enterprise): For high-traffic sites and established companies. Technical and content audits, legacy platform migrations, modern static-first infrastructure on a global edge network, security and compliance remediation, full-lifecycle management, a dedicated named team, and SLA-backed response times.
- [Care Plan](https://www.griffithcreative.co/services): Optional monthly plan covering content edits and new sections, managed hosting, uptime and performance monitoring, dependency updates, SSL, backups, and priority support.

## Differentiators

- Speed: Sites ship in weeks, not months.
- Pricing: Transparent quotes, no scope-creep invoices, no bloated agency overhead.
- Search and AI visibility: Every site is structured to rank in Google and be cited by language-model search via schema.org markup, llms.txt, semantic HTML, and answer-engine content patterns.
- Performance: High-90s Lighthouse scores measured before launch, edge-deployed on a global CDN, modern image formats.
- Scale: Enterprise practice for high-traffic sites, legacy platform migrations, and ongoing partnerships with a dedicated team.
